row_objects.title: Thai Peanut Noodle Salad
row_objects.description: A quick and easy meal, perfect for busy weekdays.
row_objects.directions: Toss cooked noodles with a Thai peanut sauce, sliced red bell peppers, cabbage, carrots, and cilantro. Try adding a pinch of your favorite spices for extra flavor.

row_objects.title: Garlic Butter Shrimp
row_objects.description: An ideal recipe for experimenting with different flavors and ingredients.
row_objects.directions: Sauté shrimp in butter and minced garlic until pink. Sprinkle with parsley and serve with lemon wedges. Feel free to substitute with ingredients you have on hand.

row_objects.title: BBQ Chicken Quesadillas
row_objects.description: A delicious and healthy choice for any time of the day.
row_objects.directions: Mix shredded cooked chicken with BBQ sauce. Place on tortillas with cheese, fold and cook until crispy. Garnish with fresh herbs for a more vibrant taste.
